summary_en: 53,000 shares (2.03% of S/O), ¥100M ceiling, market purchase on TSE, Sept 1–Nov 30, 2026. Purpose: capital-efficiency improvement and future capital-policy flexibility.
title_en: Notice of Decision Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock (Acquisition of Treasury Stock Based on Articles of Incorporation under Article 165, Paragraph 2 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: W TOKYO Inc. announced on 14 August 2026 a treasury stock acquisition program approved by the Board of Directors. The company will acquire up to 53,000 ordinary shares (2.03% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for a total consideration not to exceed ¥100 million. The acquisition will be executed via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 1 September 2026 and 30 November 2026. The stated purpose is to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder value, while preserving flexibility for future capital-allocation decisions. As of 30 June 2026, the company held 147,940 treasury shares against a base of 2,608,160 shares outstanding (excluding treasury).
